notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger or Fire Lord Ozai
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of the creature it is attached to.
Declare Hellkite Charger and Fire Lord Ozai as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Fire Lord Ozai trigger, causing you to sacrifice the token made in step 1 and add an amount of {R} equal to the token's power.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.name: Helm of the Host
uses.cardState: attached to a creature with base power 7 or greater
